Map legend

What the lines, areas and symbols on MapAround's offline map mean, as the Topo style draws them with all its options on. It's the app's own legend (Layers → Legend), made from the style's rules, with each feature's OpenStreetMap tags, the zoom it shows from (the style's and the map data's, whichever is later) and how it's drawn: colours, widths and dashes in the style's pixels.

Made from topo.xml · my-pipeline's tag-mapping.xml (540d7de)
